name: Zjolnir
summary: In Sen'jin Village, Zjolnir raises raptors for Darkspear riders and trusted Horde champions. His trained mounts carry deep cultural pride for troll riders.

sections.title: Breeder of the Darkspear Raptors
sections.body: Near Sen'jin Village's pens, Zjolnir raises the fierce raptors the Darkspear favor as mounts. Predatory and temperamental, they need an expert hand before they can be raised and saddled for war. Zjolnir freely gives these prized mounts to fellow trolls who have learned the riding arts. Other Horde members must first earn the Darkspear tribe's exalted trust before he will entrust them with one of his raptors.

faq.answer: Zjolnir tends the raptor pens in Sen'jin Village, a Darkspear settlement on Durotar's southern coast.
Zjolnir sells whistle-summoned raptors, the Darkspear trolls' racial mounts. His stock includes several breeds and colors for newly trained riders and seasoned veterans.

faq.q: Can non-trolls buy raptors from him?
aliases: who can buy mounts from zjolnir
faq.answer: Yes. Non-trolls must earn exalted standing with the Darkspear Trolls before Zjolnir will sell to them. Trolls may buy once they have the required riding skill.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you can ride the swift, clawed beasts central to your heritage and fighting traditions. Zjolnir provides them for your people.
As a Horde warrior, you can earn the right to ride one of Zjolnir's raptors into battle by proving your steadfast devotion to the Darkspear tribe.
